items.text: Boat AI improvements: dead driver flags cleared, smoother scientist boat movement with better avoidance and unsticking, roaming boats now patrol closer to coast (35 m) and stop chasing hidden players after 45 s, and lingering boat spawn bugs fixed.

Scientist AI targeting overhauled to remember lost target locations, auto‑switch to visible players, and continue attacking hidden targets for more stable encounters; also fixed a movement‑initialization bug that kept sleeping AI from receiving their first movement tick.
UZI tweaks: recoil adjusted, stock changes now block other actions, holstering cancels stock‑change animation, first‑shot animation fixed, and ADS settings refined.
Cannon dismount rotation fixed so players face the correct direction after leaving a cannon on a boat.
Item system stability: fixed stacking, use‑after‑free bugs in consumables and item durability, and other removal bugs that could cause items to disappear or malfunction.
New craftables added: Wool Armor (costs 20 wool, Tier 1 protection) and Shears (crafted from 2 blades).
Scientist loot updates: 20 % chance for a blueprint page on RHIBs and 20 % chance for a blueprint book on PT boats.
Apple spawn rebalanced: removed from oak_d, increased spawn chance on oak_e to 50 %; beehive natural‑kill warning fixed.
Seagull groups introduced: land at interest points, can be startled, transition to flocks, have hitboxes, can be shot, with improved flock movement.
Vendor crate spawning now includes missing blueprint fragments and livestock vendor rewards upgraded from fragments to full blueprint pages.
Radiation issue with the water gun fixed.
Shears no longer hurt or startle sheep (they still deal small damage to other entities).
Item stack events now correctly fire OnItemAdded and OnItemRemovedFromStack, fixing inventory‑related scripts and automation.
Ladder hatches can now be closed from any angle, restoring full interaction.

2026-10-27.summary:
### Boat & Watercraft AI
- Boat AI improvements: dead driver flags cleared, smoother scientist boat movement with better avoidance and unsticking, roaming boats now patrol closer to coast (35 m) and stop chasing hidden players after 45 s, and lingering boat spawn bugs fixed.

### Scientist & NPC Behavior
- Scientist AI targeting overhauled to remember lost target locations, auto‑switch to visible players, and continue attacking hidden targets for more stable encounters; also fixed a movement‑initialization bug that kept sleeping AI from receiving their first movement tick.

### Weapons & Combat
- UZI tweaks: recoil adjusted, stock changes now block other actions, holstering cancels stock‑change animation, first‑shot animation fixed, and ADS settings refined.
- Cannon dismount rotation fixed so players face the correct direction after leaving a cannon on a boat.

### Items, Crafting & Inventory
- Item system stability: fixed stacking, use‑after‑free bugs in consumables and item durability, and other removal bugs that could cause items to disappear or malfunction.
- New craftables added: Wool Armor (costs 20 wool, Tier 1 protection) and Shears (crafted from 2 blades).
- Scientist loot updates: 20 % chance for a blueprint page on RHIBs and 20 % chance for a blueprint book on PT boats.

### World & Resources
- Apple spawn rebalanced: removed from oak_d, increased spawn chance on oak_e to 50 %; beehive natural‑kill warning fixed.
- Seagull groups introduced: land at interest points, can be startled, transition to flocks, have hitboxes, can be shot, with improved flock movement.
- Vendor crate spawning now includes missing blueprint fragments and livestock vendor rewards upgraded from fragments to full blueprint pages.
- Radiation issue with the water gun fixed.

### Gameplay & Balance
- Shears no longer hurt or startle sheep (they still deal small damage to other entities).
- Item stack events now correctly fire OnItemAdded and OnItemRemovedFromStack, fixing inventory‑related scripts and automation.
- Ladder hatches can now be closed from any angle, restoring full interaction.

items.text: Server stalls have been dramatically reduced: crafting workshop‑skinned items now takes ~0.07 ms (down from 200 ms) and reskinning repair benches after a definitions update now takes ~0.66 ms (down from 1.27 s).
Prototype Workbench Upgrade now has a 25 % success chance (instead of always failing), increasing average blueprint consumption and adding a failure sound.
Item pool size increased from 512 to 2,048, reducing overflow and allowing larger loot batches.
Underwater crates now contain blueprint fragments and pages, and fish gutting now has a 20 % chance to yield a blueprint fragment instead of 8 cloth.
Cows follow the player smoothly when led, can meet their light requirement using lamps, and no longer clip through walls while lying down.
All livestock now flee when attacked from a distance and no longer sleep, fixing AI issues.
Vending machines now block sight like doors, restoring proper base occlusion.
Foundations adjacent to walls no longer incorrectly connect across offsets, fixing unintended visibility leaks.
AI Sleep Zones function correctly again, allowing sleepers to rest as intended.
Sheep now feed properly from troughs without starving, aligning their feeding cycle with cows.
Water Purifiers no longer add extra garbage to output stacks before removal, ensuring correct resource handling.
Sprinklers reliably produce splash effects and maintain fuel, eliminating missed splashes and brief fuel gaps.
Static CCTV cameras work again, restoring surveillance functionality.
Bag markers assigned while dead now appear on the map immediately, preventing loss of tracking after death.
Ramps now correctly calculate line‑of‑sight, removing false blue LOS blocks.

2026-10-26.summary:
### Server Performance
- Server stalls have been dramatically reduced: crafting workshop‑skinned items now takes ~0.07 ms (down from 200 ms) and reskinning repair benches after a definitions update now takes ~0.66 ms (down from 1.27 s).

### Crafting, Blueprint & Loot
- Prototype Workbench Upgrade now has a 25 % success chance (instead of always failing), increasing average blueprint consumption and adding a failure sound.
- Item pool size increased from 512 to 2,048, reducing overflow and allowing larger loot batches.
- Underwater crates now contain blueprint fragments and pages, and fish gutting now has a 20 % chance to yield a blueprint fragment instead of 8 cloth.

### Animals & Livestock
- Cows follow the player smoothly when led, can meet their light requirement using lamps, and no longer clip through walls while lying down.
- All livestock now flee when attacked from a distance and no longer sleep, fixing AI issues.

### Base & Visibility
- Vending machines now block sight like doors, restoring proper base occlusion.
- Foundations adjacent to walls no longer incorrectly connect across offsets, fixing unintended visibility leaks.

### AI & Animals
- AI Sleep Zones function correctly again, allowing sleepers to rest as intended.
- Sheep now feed properly from troughs without starving, aligning their feeding cycle with cows.

### Items & Processing
- Water Purifiers no longer add extra garbage to output stacks before removal, ensuring correct resource handling.
- Sprinklers reliably produce splash effects and maintain fuel, eliminating missed splashes and brief fuel gaps.

### Security & Surveillance
- Static CCTV cameras work again, restoring surveillance functionality.

### Map & UI
- Bag markers assigned while dead now appear on the map immediately, preventing loss of tracking after death.

### Ramp Visibility
- Ramps now correctly calculate line‑of‑sight, removing false blue LOS blocks.
